item.name: Candles
item.description: REST API for candle (OHLCV) operations — download, query local data, and IBKR connection.

request.description: Download historical data for a single ticker and timeframe from IBKR TWS.
Download all timeframes for a single ticker from IBKR TWS.
Download all timeframes for every configured ticker.
Load candles from local CSV/SQLite storage for a given ticker and timeframe.
Check whether local candle data exists for a given ticker and timeframe.
Returns IBKR TWS connection status for the data client.
Connect the IBKR data client to TWS.

item.name: Strategies
item.description: REST API for strategy scanning — run signal detection across all or a single ticker.

request.description: Scan all configured tickers against all strategies and return signals.
Scan a single ticker against all strategies.

item.name: Trading
item.description: REST API for manual trade execution and account management via IBKR TWS.

request.description: Scan all tickers and optionally auto-execute the resulting signals.
Manually execute a single option trade signal via IBKR.
Check whether a ticker has a valid option chain available in IBKR.
Returns account balance, risk limit per trade, active trade count, and canTrade flag.
Connect to IBKR Account Manager to sync the account balance.

item.name: Backtest
item.description: REST API for running backtests, learning loops, and strategy analysis.

request.description: Run a backtest for specific tickers and date range. Omit 'tickers' to use all configured tickers.
Run a backtest using the full configured ticker list.
Get the current ticker memory learning report as a formatted string.
Get AI-powered (Ollama) analysis of the current learning report.
Start the continuous learning loop (training mode). Runs asynchronously — returns 202 Accepted.
Stop the currently running continuous learning loop.
Check whether the learning loop is currently running.
Analyze the latest backtest results from backtest/trades.csv and get improvement suggestions.
Get ticker information, optionally filtered by sector, market cap range, or quality/growth flags.
Get the list of priority tickers (top N by fundamentals). Set refresh=true to recompute.
Get detailed fundamental score breakdown for a specific ticker.
Run strategy screener across all tickers (stub in v1 — requires candle data integration).

item.name: Backtest Dashboard UI
item.description: Web dashboard API for interactive backtest runs, SSE progress streaming, grid search, and strategy improvement.

request.description: Redirects to the React SPA at /.
Server-Sent Events stream for real-time backtest progress (10 min timeout).
Start a synchronous backtest via the dashboard. Returns immediately if another is already running.
Check whether a backtest is currently running and get scheduler status.
Stop the currently running backtest.
Get the current max concurrent scan setting for the backtest engine.
Set the max concurrent scans for the backtest engine (1–16).
Check whether a resume checkpoint exists and list processed tickers.
Clear the backtest resume checkpoint file.
Resume a backtest from a saved checkpoint via SSE progress stream.
Get the current auto-run scheduler state and parameters.
Enable/disable the auto-run scheduler and/or update its parameters.
Analyze an underperforming strategy and get improvement recommendations. Optionally scope to a single ticker via ?ticker=AAPL.
Retest a strategy with adjusted TP/SL multiplier deltas and compare against the previous run baseline.

{
  "tickers": ["AAPL", "SPY"],

request.description: Run exhaustive or random grid search over TP/SL multiplier deltas. Max cells controlled by grid-search.max-cells in yml. searchMode: EXHAUSTIVE or RANDOM.
Promote grid-search deltas to persisted ATR multiplier overrides in ticker memory. Set dryRun=true to preview.
List all strategy profiles that have TP/SL ATR overrides stored in ticker memory.
Remove TP/SL ATR overrides for one ticker+strategy from ticker memory.

item.name: Live Mode
item.description: Live Mode dashboard API — market scanning, signal management, trade execution, and replay mode.

request.description: Redirects to the React SPA at /.
Get full live scan status: isScanning, tickers, scanner progress, settings, macro regime, etc.
Get all current live signals, executed trades, closed trades, and signal counts.
Get the per-ticker scan activity feed (sorted by HOT priority).
Get all tickers and hot tickers in the current universe.
Get detailed TWS connection status (data, account, exec clients) and account balance.
Get market session (REGULAR / OPEN EXT / CLOSED), current ET time, and countdown to next open.
Get the latest scan-score breakdown by ticker (scoresByTicker + scanStartedAt timestamp).
Returns whether the IBKR account is in PAPER or LIVE mode.
Returns tickers with active news alerts (stub — empty list until TWS news integration).
Trigger a manual live scan. Blocked outside market hours (10:00–22:00 Spain, Mon–Fri) unless mock mode is on.
Request an orderly stop of the current scan and interrupt in-flight IBKR downloads.
Force-stop any ongoing scan and reset all scanning state. Use after inconsistent restart.
Manually execute a live signal via IBKR TWS.
Execute a trade directly. Same behavior as execute-signal.
Close a trade: cancels TP/SL orders in TWS if IDs provided, otherwise marks as manually closed locally.
Send a cancellation request to TWS for a given orderId.
Remove a live signal row from the grid. Blocked if the ticker has an open executed position.
Delete all signals older than 30 minutes that do not have an open position.
Delete multiple signal rows by ticker list. Skips tickers with open positions.
Inject a mock signal for testing. Cycles through all 12 strategies if strategy is omitted.
Set max concurrent scanner threads for the live scan (1–16).
Set live ticker filter (comma-separated symbols) and scope (HOT or ALL).
Override runtime risk percentage per trade (pct=2 means 2%).
Toggle extended hours scanning on/off.
Toggle the runtime auto-execute flag for live signals.
Toggle the macro environment filter (VIX regime check) on/off.
Toggle the market scanner auto-scheduler on/off.
Toggle mock market-open mode (bypasses market hours check for testing).
List TWS positions not opened by this application. Returns 503 if TWS disconnected.
Immediately close an external position with a market SELL order in TWS.
Schedule a conditional market SELL at 14:50 ET for an external position. Idempotent — returns 409 if already scheduled.
Start live replay mode for a historical date at the given speed multiplier. Requires replay.enabled=true in yml.
Stop live replay mode and clear replay signals.
Change replay speed multiplier while replay is running.
Get current replay state: active, virtualNow, speed, runId, replay signal count.

item.name: Ticker Config
item.description: ABM API for ticker universe, HOT priority list, hot-ticker-count, and fundamental overrides.

request.description: Get the full runtime ticker configuration: universe, hot list, fundamentals, and file state flags.
Replace the full runtime ticker configuration. Persists to data/ticker-runtime.json and triggers reload.
Remove a symbol from the universe and fundamentals map in the runtime file.
Validate a ticker symbol against IBKR TWS. Returns valid=false with a reason if TWS is not connected.
Get effective hot-ticker count: runtimeOverride, ymlDefault, and effectiveCount.
Persist a runtime override for hot-ticker-count (1–100). Returns 400 if out of range.

item.name: Backup
item.description: Settings backup API — saves a raw settings snapshot to disk.

request.description: Save a settings snapshot. Body is passed as-is to BackupService and written to disk.

item.name: Charts
item.description: Serves backtest chart HTML files from backtest/charts/ directory.

request.description: Serve a backtest chart HTML file. Handles timestamp format variations (HH-MM vs HH-MM-SS). Path traversal is blocked.

item.name: Telegram Webhook
item.description: Webhook for Telegram callback queries and bot commands. Must include X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token header.

request.description: Telegram callback_query webhook. data format: E|TICKER|STRATEGY|PRICE|DIRECTION. Requires valid secret token header.
Telegram bot command via message. Supported: /status, /help, /pause, /resume.
